name: Nilgiri Sholakili
rangeDescription: Peninsular india (nilgiri hills of mysore and western madras)
description: Dumpy little bird, slaty-blue with a tan belly. Highly restricted and scattered range in the Nilgiri Hills, where it is found at 900-2100 meters of elevation in sholas (patches of stunted montane forest separated by open grassy areas).

name: Indigo Flowerpiercer
rangeDescription: Andes of western colombia and northwestern ecuador (southward to pichincha)
description: Small flowerpiercer with restricted range in western Colombia and northwest Ecuador. Entirely ultramarine blue, though can appear dark in poor light.

name: Siberian House-Martin
rangeDescription: Siberia to mongolia and manchuria; winters to southern china and thailand
description: Distinctive small swallow with blue-black upperparts, a very large white rump patch, and snow-white underparts. Juvenile in late summer and autumn is duller above and dingier below than adult.

name: Gray Flycatcher
rangeDescription: Breeds western north america; winters to southern mexico
description: Drab, pale-gray flycatcher with little plumage contrast; very similar to other flycatchers, especially Dusky and Hammond's. Often best identified by unique habit of wagging tail downward.

name: Swierstra's Spurfowl
rangeDescription: Montane forest of western angola (cuanza sul to huila)
description: Rare and unusual francolin that is endemic to Angola. Note the red bill and legs, mostly white face, black breast band, and black-striped white underparts.

name: Kilombero Cisticola
rangeDescription: Southern tanzania (kilombero swamp)
description: A large, relatively colorful marsh cisticola. Note the rufous cap, the short white eyebrow stripe, and the pale and black bands at the tip of the tail.

name: Odedi
rangeDescription: Bougainville (northwestern solomon islands)
description: A small, round-bodied, cock-tailed skulking warbler. Appears three-toned: dark slaty gray below, chestnut brown above, with a paler rufous head and a slightly darker eye-stripe.

name: Fairy Prion
rangeDescription: Breeds scattered subtropical and subantarctic islands
description: The smallest of the six prion species, the fairy prion is often seen making shallow dives or seizing food from the surface in large flocks at sea. It is very similar to other prion species, with a dark “M'' stretching across the back from wingtip to wingtip and a black tip to the upper tail.

name: Huayco Tinamou
rangeDescription: Andes of northwestern bolivia to northwestern argentina
description: Large, streaky tinamou of upper elevations of the east side of the Andes. The highland version of Red-winged Tinamou, similar in voice and habits.

name: Sclater's Antwren
rangeDescription: Eastern peru south of the amazon river, northern bolivia, and southern amazonian brazil
description: Small yellow-and-black streaked antwren of mature rainforest canopy. Males are yellow with extensive black streaking; females are similar, with a reddish wash in the face.

name: Madagascar Grebe
rangeDescription: Madagascar
description: Small, dark grebe that is endemic to Madagascar. The neck is rufous and white in breeding plumage and buff in non-breeding plumage.

name: Red-bellied Woodpecker
rangeDescription: Eastern north america (southern canada to texas and florida keys)
description: Medium-sized woodpecker that is not well named; rarely is the slight red wash on the belly visible! Instead, note the black-and-white barring on the back and wings, plain buffy breast and face, and red nape.

name: Black-headed Gull
rangeDescription: Northern palearctic; winters to africa, southern asia, and eastern north america
description: Fairly small gull, common and widespread across Eurasia. All plumages have big white blaze on leading edge of wing.

name: Chinese Egret
rangeDescription: Eastern asia; winters to southeastern asia, philippines, and indonesia
description: Medium-sized white egret. Breeding adult has bright blue loral skin, a pinkish-orange bill, and long frilly plumes on the head, neck, and back.

name: Black-and-white Hawk-Eagle
rangeDescription: Forest of southern mexico to northern argentina and brazil
description: Rare but spectacular eagle of lowland tropical forest. Very rarely seen perched, when black mask, orange-yellow base of bill, and short black crest are distinctive.

name: Zanzibar Boubou
rangeDescription: Southern somalia, kenya, and northeastern tanzania; zanzibar
description: A heavily built black-and-white bushshrike. The upperparts are cleanly black and the underparts are white with a pinkish tinge.

name: Rusty-breasted Wren-Babbler
rangeDescription: Montane forest of western sumatra
description: Chunky babbler of the forest floor and understory in Sumatra’s highlands. Mostly dark brown, with a white throat, dark scaling on the upperparts, and the namesake rust-colored breast.

name: Sykes's Warbler
rangeDescription: Breeds lower volga river eastward to eastern kazakhstan (lake balkhash) and extreme western china (western and central xinjiang), southward to southern iran, afghanistan, and western pakistan, locally in northwestern india; small resident population in northeastern united arab emirates (khor kalba) and northwestern oman (mangroves of batinah coast); non-breeding to indian subcontinent
description: Plain brown warbler with pale legs. Breeds in Central Asia; winters primarily on the Indian peninsula.

name: Taiwan Rosefinch
rangeDescription: Mountains of taiwan
description: Endemic to Taiwan's mountain forests, this is the only breeding rosefinch on the island. Male deep wine-red with a frosty white brow and dark wings.

name: Black-and-orange Flycatcher
rangeDescription: Mountains of southwestern india (western maharashtra southward to kerala)
description: Tiny, brightly-colored flycatcher. Female is slightly paler than the male, particularly on the head.
